functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must collect all required fields (name, gender, password, mobile number, location) for account creation, ensuring 100% of these fields are present and correctly formatted.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR specifies the need to collect all these details for account creation, requiring full coverage of these fields.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must validate the format and uniqueness of each field (e.g., email format, password strength, unique username) with a 99.9% accuracy rate.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate data validation to ensure the integrity of the account creation process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The account creation process must complete within 5 seconds for 95% of users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction, and quick processing enhances user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The account creation interface must be designed so that 90% of new users can successfully create an account within 3 minutes of their first attempt.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a user-friendly interface to facilitate account creation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide real-time feedback on input errors and suggest corrections, reducing user errors by at least 50%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input, which can benefit from error prevention and correction mechanisms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The account creation service must be available 99.9% of the time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous availability of the account creation feature.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All user data entered during account creation must be encrypted using AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves collecting sensitive personal information, requiring strong encryption for data protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must use checksums or digital signatures to ensure the integrity of user data during account creation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the protection of user data from unauthorized changes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The account creation module must be designed so that changes to the required fields or validation rules can be implemented within 2 hours of development time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR may need updates over time, requiring a maintainable design.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to import and manage various data formats like images, videos, and audio files within presentations.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support importing and managing at least the following file formats: JPEG, PNG, MP4, MOV, MP3, and WAV, covering 100% of the specified data types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle various data formats, necessitating full coverage of these formats.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must correctly process and render 99.9% of valid file inputs without data loss or corruption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate processing of different file types.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must import and render files within 5 seconds for files up to 100 MB in size.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction with media files, requiring timely processing for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 1 GB of memory to process a single file import or management operation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for handling multiple files and maintaining system performance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a user-friendly interface for importing and managing files, with drag-and-drop functionality and clear visual feedback on file status.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires ease of use for importing and managing various file types.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must validate file types before import and provide clear error messages for unsupported formats, reducing user errors by at least 75%.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input, which can benefit from error prevention and correction mechanisms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must gracefully handle file import failures without crashing, with a recovery mechanism to retry failed imports.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous operation, requiring fault tolerance for file handling.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must use checksums to verify the integrity of files during import and management operations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves managing user files, requiring protection against data corruption.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The file import and management module must be designed so that new file formats can be added within 4 hours of development time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR may need updates to support additional file formats, requiring a maintainable design.
